name: Manometer
description: A panel of pressure gauges: cream dials ringed in grey with a green band and a red band, ticked round three quarters, each needle swung to its own reading.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-clip-path: circle(46% at 50% 50%); clip-path: circle(46% at 50% 50%); background: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, @p(var(--color1)) 76%, transparent 76%), @var(--zones); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color4); -webkit-mask: @var(--ticks), radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 58%, #000 58% 70%, transparent 70%); mask: @var(--ticks), radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 58%, #000 58% 70%, transparent 70%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color4), var(--color3)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--needle); clip-path: @var(--needle); -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(-128 + 256 * max(0, min(1, @rn(-0.4, 1.4, 1.3))))deg); transform: rotate(@calc(-128 + 256 * max(0, min(1, @rn(-0.4, 1.4, 1.3))))deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --ticks: conic-gradient(from 223.5deg, #000 0deg 3deg, transparent 3deg 27deg, #000 27deg 30deg, transparent 30deg 54deg, #000 54deg 57deg, transparent 57deg 81deg, #000 81deg 84deg, transparent 84deg 108deg, #000 108deg 111deg, transparent 111deg 135deg, #000 135deg 138deg, transparent 138deg 162deg, #000 162deg 165deg, transparent 165deg 189deg, #000 189deg 192deg, transparent 192deg 216deg, #000 216deg 219deg, transparent 219deg 243deg, #000 243deg 246deg, transparent 246deg 270deg, #000 270deg 273deg, transparent 273deg 360deg); --needle: polygon(51.6% 44.22%, 53.17% 44.91%, 54.48% 46.01%, 55.43% 47.45%, 55.93% 49.09%, 55.95% 50.81%, 55.47% 52.46%, 54.55% 53.91%, 53.26% 55.04%, 51.7% 55.75%, 50% 56%, 48.3% 55.75%, 46.74% 55.04%, 45.45% 53.91%, 44.53% 52.46%, 44.05% 50.81%, 44.07% 49.09%, 44.57% 47.45%, 45.52% 46.01%, 46.83% 44.91%, 48.4% 44.22%, 50% 14%); --zones: conic-gradient(from 225deg, var(--color5) 0 120deg, var(--color2) 120deg 200deg, var(--color3) 200deg 270deg, var(--color2) 270deg 360deg); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
